summary: End-to-end testing of Azad School full-stack app. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (auth, admissions, contacts, gallery upload + serve + soft-delete, announcements CRUD, stats, admin protection, _id leakage check, JWT cookie). Frontend: All public pages (Home/Admissions/Gallery/Contact) render correctly with proper data-testids. Admin login works with seeded credentials, dashboard shows all 5 sidebar sections (Overview, Admissions, Contacts, Gallery, Announcements), each panel renders with proper testids. Logout redirects to /admin/login. Google Maps iframe present on contact page (data-testid='contact-map'). No critical issues found.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> injected as child of <option> (likely from data-ve instrumentation on classes.map). Cosmetic console warning, not user-visible. Consider suppressing or restructuring select options.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: All endpoints exclude _id properly via projection. Good.
server.py: bcrypt password hashing used correctly ($2b$ format). Seed admin updates password if changed - matches playbook.
server.py: JWT cookie httpOnly+samesite=lax, secure=false (preview env). Token also returned in response body for non-cookie clients.
server.py: No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Consider rate-limiting /api/auth/login if security hardening needed.
server.py: CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True - browsers will reject this combo. Currently unused since same-origin via ingress, but should be explicit origins for production.
server.py: PATCH admissions uses Form(...) for status; works but JSON body would be more consistent with rest of API.
Frontend: Excellent data-testid coverage across all interactive elements.
seed_data_creation: Backend creates seed admin + 3 demo announcements at startup. Tests left ~5 TEST_-prefixed admissions/contacts/announcements + 1 soft-deleted gallery image in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows pass. Contact form testids: contact-input-name, contact-input-email, contact-input-phone, contact-input-subject, contact-input-message, contact-submit-btn. Admin login: admin-login-email, admin-login-password, admin-login-submit. Sidebar links: sidebar-{overview,admissions,contacts,gallery,announcements}. Announcements panel: announcement-title/category/body/submit, delete-announcement-{id}. Gallery: gallery-title-input/category-select/upload-input. Admissions multi-step uses input-{student-name,dob,gender,class,prev-school} and step-1-next.
rca of the issue: No bugs. CORS '*' + allow_credentials is technically invalid but doesn't manifest because ingress proxies same-origin.
